_readme: Golden set for `make eval`. Every case is executed through the real /api/v1/chat
route and graded on the response — nothing here is graded against its own prose.
expect_top_doc is the document the FIRST citation must come from. It is the sharpest
signal available offline: the original defect was a patent question whose first
citation was the Trade Marks Act, because that document contains the word 'recipe'.
Out-of-scope cases exist so abstention accuracy can fall below 1.0. The previous set
had a single should_abstain case out of six, so the metric could barely move.

cases.query: Can I patent my grandmother's churna recipe?
cases.note: The README's own demo question. It abstained at confidence 24.7 before the recalibration.

cases.query: Is my Ayurvedic formulation patentable?
cases.note: 'patentable' matched no keyword before the suffix fix, so this classified as UNKNOWN.

cases.query: I made a novel Ashwagandha extract with 10x withanolide by a new process — can I patent it?
How do I register a trademark for my brand name?
Can I copyright my Ayurveda textbook and its compilation?
cases.note: Returned the trademark verdict before, because the Trade Marks Act was among the retrieved spans.

cases.query: How do I protect my family recipe as a trade secret?
cases.note: Returned the FSSAI food/drug verdict before.

cases.query: Can I register the design of my churna bottle and carton packaging?
Can I get a GI tag for my regional rice variety?
cases.note: Either is a correct lead: the GI Act defines the right, the InPASS guide says how to file. The registry guide currently leads on title match.

cases.query: Do I need NBA approval to export aloe vera sourced in Kerala for cosmetic manufacture?
What documents does FSSAI need to sell chyawanprash as Ayurveda Aahar?
What is the WIPO GRATK disclosure requirement when filing with an Indian genetic resource?
How do I file a PCT application for my formulation?
cases.note: Matched no IP keyword before PCT was added to the patent pattern, and returned the GRATK verdict.

cases.query: What does the Nagoya Protocol require for benefit sharing?
क्या मैं अपने पुराने नुस्खे का पेटेंट करा सकता हूँ?
cases.note: Indic script. Without the term bridge this scored near zero against every document and abstained.
